g.text: OpenTofu provisioning · Argo CD reconciliation · AWS burst capacity · platform service flows
AWS OIDC · GitHub Environment · Doppler tokens
OpenTofu owns Cilium, Gateway API CRDs, Argo CD and Karpenter. Argo CD owns the remaining platform.
KubeSpan: encrypted WireGuard mesh (UDP 51820). Worker KubePrism discovers control-plane endpoints at localhost:7445.
Collectors run on every prod node, including AWS workers.
Persistent data + GPUs stay on Proxmox.
Kubeflow includes notebooks, training and model serving.
Execution controllers · managed by Argo CD
GPU jobs stay on fixed capacity. AWS workers require stateless opt-in.
Other operators: Talos CCM, metrics-server, cert-manager, Strimzi, MongoDB.
